paper_reference.paper_question: 存在未观测共同原因时，什么图结构允许通过观测中介识别干预分布？
paper_reference.source_location: Pearl (1995), §3.2 front-door criterion, Theorem 2, Eq. (9), pp. 675-677.
paper_reference.formula: p(y|do(x)) = sum_z p(z|x) sum_{x'} p(y|x',z) p(x').
conditions: Mediator Z intercepts all directed paths from X to Y.
No unblocked back-door path from X to Z.
All back-door paths from Z to Y are blocked by X.
Observed joint distribution is available and positive.
what_paper_supports: Front-door identification with an observed mediator.
The inner x' sum is distinct from the outer intervention x.
The three graphical conditions are required.
what_paper_does_not_support: No front-door formula when mediator completeness fails.
No medical fact claim from the synthetic graph.

changed_target.reason: Adding a direct X->Y edge breaks the front-door conditions; no connected method.
